about: Lane file ownership for the Nimbus harness rebuild, read by tools/release_gate/check_lane_files.py: a lane's merge may touch only the files of its entry, the shared entries and its per-lane entries. Built by hand from each lane's files_owned text in the program's PLAN.json (plan_text keeps that text verbatim, so a change in the plan fails --check-plan until the entry is rebuilt). Globs: '*' stays inside one folder, '**' spans folders. hot_files is the one-writer-at-a-time order of PRD section 10; --overlaps lists every path two lanes own and whether that order sequences it. The gate sees whole files: qualifiers in the plan text such as (first holder), (format only), (engine-2 part) or a line range are not enforced by it, only by review. A lane may also edit test/<suite>/** where the base roster names it for a pending test there.
source: program-2026-10-18/rebuild/PLAN.json lanes[].files_owned and PRD.md section 10, 18 Nov 2026

shared.why: Docs ride the change: each lane edits its own sections in the same commit (PRD section 10, AGENTS.md section 7).
Generated by tools/gen_docs_pack.py from docs/; every lane that edits a shipped doc regenerates it on rebase.
The engine-2 docs pack, generated the same way once RB-D0 lands.
An implementing lane removes its own roster lines; check_pending_roster.py fails any line that is not in the base roster, so the file can only shrink.

per_lane.why: Every lane carries its own image allowance (PRD section 10).
The tg_poll stack ratchet has a named path row per lane (PRD section 10).
